title: Gitar Dijual
subject: a student selling his guitar to pay the boarding-house rent, and the buyer, a high-school kid, asks him to play one last song before taking it
caption: Indonesian folk-pop band in the reflective 2025 streaming style. A fingerpicked nylon-string guitar with soft thumb bass notes; a strummed ukulele on the off-beats; an acoustic bass walking gently under the chorus; a brushed cajon keeping a light shuffle; a breathy harmonica answering the vocal between lines. Warm and dry, bedroom-close, wood and strings forward. Male voice, a soft close baritone singing like he is telling a friend, a female harmony joining on the last chorus. 84 BPM, D major. Quiet, rueful, a little proud. No electric guitar solo, no drum kit, no autotune, no orchestral strings, no EDM build.
lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked nylon guitar]

[Verse 1]
Kupasang di marketplace, tujuh ratus nego
Foto di kasur kos, senarnya baru kuganti
Yang dateng anak SMA, naik motor sama bapaknya
Uangnya dihitung pelan, lecek semua, ribuan

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia bilang, Mas, sekali lagi aja
Mainin lagu yang Mas paling bisa

[Chorus]
Jadi kumainkan pelan di teras kos
Lagu yang dulu kupakai nembak Rina, gagal
Bapaknya ngangguk, anaknya diem
Gitarku pamit, bayar sewa bulan ini

[Verse 2]
Ada stiker band di belakang badannya
Bekas tutup botol nempel di dekat lubang
Kubilang jangan dicopot, itu dari Jogja
Dia ketawa, iya Mas, nanti kutambahin

[Pre-Chorus]
Ibu kos lewat bawa kunci
Kali ini nggak nanya kapan bayar lagi

[Chorus]
Jadi kumainkan pelan di teras kos
Lagu yang dulu kupakai nembak Rina, gagal
Motornya pergi, gitarnya di punggung
Kayaknya di tangan dia lagunya bakal jadi

[Outro - ukulele alone]
Bulan depan aku nyanyi pakai meja
Ketukannya nggak fals, kok
